<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/chat/conversations/{conversationId}/messages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Text, an upload path, or both are required. Private attachments must
be fresh uploads owned by the sender and become conversation-scoped
atomically with the message. `replyToMessageId` may reference only an
existing message in this same conversation. Unknown or cross-conversation
ids are rejected with the same 404 response.
